formulation: solution for subcutaneous injection (vial and prefilled syringe)

approval_evidence.quote: We have completed our review of this application, as amended. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon labeling text. (FDA approval letter, BLA 761090, TAKHZYRO (lanadelumab), signed 08/23/2018)

launch_evidence.quote: Encouraging early trajectory of TAKHZYRO since U.S. launch on August 23, 2018 with $51 million in initial launch stocking. (Shire plc Q3 2018 earnings release, Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1, filed 2018-11-01)

series_start_reason: Takeda prints a Takhzyro line only from fiscal Q4 FY2018 (January-March 2019), the first quarter after it completed the Shire acquisition on 2019-01-08; the product was launched in the U.S. on 2018-08-23 under Shire, whose USD figures (an initial-stocking amount in its Q3 2018 release, and prose in 'Shire's Full Year 2018 Results' furnished by Takeda on Form 6-K 2019-02-15) are a different issuer and currency and are not spliced. The FY2018 column of the FY2018 Q4 table (Form 6-K filed 2019-05-14) is headed 'Shire 3 Months', so the 2019Q1 figure covers January 8 to March 31, 2019. The series starts two quarters after launch.
notes: Scope is Takeda's worldwide Takhzyro line (JPY, actual rates). Every row is from a document Takeda furnished to the SEC (Form 6-K or 20-F, CIK 1395064). Units vary by document: Bn JPY to one decimal in the FY2018 summary, the FY2019 quarterly securities reports' underlying-revenue tables and the FY2024-FY2026 earnings-release prose; JPY millions in the revenue-by-product notes of the FY2020-FY2023 quarterly securities reports, the FY2024-FY2025 half-year reports and the 20-F revenue-by-product tables. From FY2024 Takeda furnished no quarterly securities report for the first and third quarters (only the earnings release), and its half-year report and 20-F print six-month and full-year figures, so FY2024-FY2025 Q2 is half-year less Q1, Q3 is the nine-month release figure less half-year, and Q4 is full year less nine months. FY2019 Q2-Q4 are likewise derived from year-to-date figures; Q4 of each fiscal year is full year (20-F) less nine months. Rows mixing a 0.1-billion input are approximate to 0.1 billion JPY.
search_log: listed Takeda's EDGAR submissions (data.sec.gov/submissions CIK0001395064 plus older shards): 708 filings, 345 6-K, 8 20-F; no quarterly product filings exist before the 20FR12B of 2018-12-06

fetched index.json and every .htm document of each 6-K filed in Jan, Feb, Apr, May, Jul, Aug, Oct, Nov 2018-12 to 2026-10, plus each 20-F/20FR12B primary document; counted brand-name hits (filter: those months only, 6-K/20-F/20FR12B forms only)

earnings-material 6-Ks selected per fiscal quarter: FY2018 Q4 summary (2019-05-14); FY2019 Q1-Q3 quarterly securities reports (2019-08-09, 2019-11-12, 2020-02-13); FY2020-FY2023 Q1-Q3 quarterly securities reports; FY2024-FY2025 half-year reports (2024-10-31, 2025-10-30); FY2024-FY2026 Q1 and FY2024-FY2025 Q3 earnings releases; 20-Fs for fiscal years ended March 2020-2026

the FY2019 quarterly securities reports print Takhzyro only in the underlying-revenue table (Q1 three months, H1 and Q3 YTD cumulative), so FY2019 Q2 and Q3 are derived from year-to-date figures; FY2020-FY2023 Q2/Q3 reports print a three-month revenue-by-product note beside the cumulative one, and the three-month note was used

from FY2024 the Q1 and Q3 filings are earnings releases only; each prints 'Sales of TAKHZYRO (for hereditary angioedema) were JPY x billion' (three months in Q1, nine months in Q3), checked in the FY2024 Q1/Q3, FY2025 Q1/Q3 and FY2026 Q1 releases

Q4 rows are full year from the 20-F revenue-by-product table less nine months; by construction each fiscal year's four quarters add to the 20-F full year (FY2019 68,271; FY2020 86,718; FY2021 103,242; FY2022 151,800; FY2023 178,677; FY2024 223,163; FY2025 223,924 JPY millions)

cross-check: the FY2020-FY2023 three-month figures sum with the corresponding Q1 figures to the six-month and nine-month notes in the same reports (e.g. FY2020 23,245 + 20,497 = 43,742 six months; + 22,149 = 65,891 nine months)
